betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Quartz Fiber is a clever little cable segment. It passes AE power between two network segments but does NOT pass data or channels.

This means you can share a power source across multiple independent networks without merging them. Each side of the Fiber belongs to a separate network, connected only for power sharing.

Use cases:
§b-§f Powering a sub-network from your main backbone without channel bleed
§b-§f Running power to a isolated network for security or organization
§b-§f Splitting a large network into manageable channel segments

Craft with Quartz Glass, Fluix Dust, and Gold Cable.

§9Note:§f The Fiber itself does not consume channels. It is purely a power bridge.
